system.description: You touch a massive object, up to the size of a cottage.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts 1 hour.
outcomes.success: The object becomes weightless for 10 minutes. You could push a boulder with your little finger or carry a capsized barge on your back.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The weight comes to you instead: you are Encumbered for 1 hour. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
